DROP TABLE dw.factdepytdbal_Balance
DROP TABLE dw.factdepytdbal_join_balance
DROP TABLE dw.factdepytdbal_rowgrp
DROP TABLE dw.factdepytdbal_final_balance

WITH CasaTdAggregateBalance AS(
    SELECT  * FROM [BNKM].[CasaTdAggregateBalance] WHERE AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance'
    
	),
	
Cnt_DimCustomerAccount AS(
    SELECT BCB.CustomerAccountId, COUNT(1) CNT FROM CasaTdAggregateBalance BCB
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount_TEST_20231004 DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID 
    and DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY BCB.CustomerAccountId),
	
Balance AS (
SELECT 
	BCB.PeriodEndDate AS BusinessDateSK
	,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
	,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
	,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
	,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
	,BCB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
    ,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode
    ,BCA.FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCB.AccumulatedCurrentBalance AS BalanceAmount
    ,ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1) CNT
FROM CasaTdAggregateBalance BCB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCB.CustomerAccountid = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialproductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON convert(varchar,BCA.BranchId) = DDB.BranchID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON convert(varchar,BCB.FinancialInstitutionId) = convert(varchar,DDBK.BankID)
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DIMACCOUNT_TEST_20231004] DDA ON convert(varchar,BCB.CustomerAccountId) = convert(varchar,DDA.AccountID)
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA','SBA','TDA'))
---SELECT COUNT(*) from BALANCE
select * into dw.factdepytdbal_Balance from Balance;
---SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dw.factdepytdbal_Balance --- 2,514,897
-------


with GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
    BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,convert(DATE, MIN(BusinessDateSK)) AS min_date
    ,CONVERT(DATE, MAX(BusinessDateSK)) AS max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.factdepytdbal_Balance
WHERE (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    --AND 
    BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL) --AND BusinessDateSK >= '2023-01-01'
	GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
	,SourceSystemCode
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,fulldate,112) AS fulldate2
    ,a.FullDate
    ,b.min_date 
    ,b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
WHERE (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    --AND 
    BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,distinct_balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountId ,BusinessDateSK ,BalanceAmount ,SourceSystemCode ,WorkFlowId ,TaskRunId ,InsertDttm ,IsoCurrencyCode ,FinancialInstitutionId ,CNT
FROM  dw.factdepytdbal_Balance b
WHERE (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    --AND 
    BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
, join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BalanceAmount
,CNT
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [BalanceAmount] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON --a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    --AND 
    a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)
select * into dw.factdepytdbal_join_balance from join_balance;

------

select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup into dw.factdepytdbal_rowgrp from dw.factdepytdbal_join_balance;



------

with final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode is not null then BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
,case when BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId is not null then BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [BalanceAmount] is not null then BalanceAmount else first_value(BalanceAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end BalanceAmount
,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CNT
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm                           
from dw.factdepytdbal_rowgrp BCPB) 

select * into dw.factdepytdbal_final_balance from final_balance;

---SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dw.factdepytdbal_final_balance --- 2,514,777

------

with CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)

---INSERT INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD_TEST_20231004  
---(
---BusinessDateSK
---,BranchSK
---,BankSK
---,AccountSK
---,AccountID
---,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
---,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
---,SourceSystemCode
---,WorkFlowId
---,TaskRunId
---,InsertDttm)
, test AS (
select 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,convert(date,BusinessDateSK),112) as BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate) / DDD.DayOfYear
    ELSE BalanceAmount/DDD.DayOfYear END AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN ((BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ CNT) / DDD.DayOfYear
    ELSE (BalanceAmount / CNT ) / DDD.DayOfYear
    END AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm     
from  dw.factdepytdbal_final_balance   BCPB
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON  BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode  = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCPB.BusinessDateSK) = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMDATE DDD ON  CONVERT(VARCHAR,convert(date,BusinessDateSK),112) = DDD.DateSK
)
SELECT SUM(AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull) FROM test WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127
